name: Protection
tagline: An energetic boundary you can wear.
description: For the days you walk into rooms that take more than they give. Protection stones are traditionally worn to deflect what isn't yours and keep your own energy close.
seoDescription: Protection crystal bracelets in black tourmaline, obsidian and hematite, traditionally worn as a boundary. Made in Dubai, next-day UAE delivery.
definition: A protection bracelet is a crystal bracelet strung from stones traditionally worn to absorb or deflect other people's energy: black tourmaline, black obsidian, hematite and smoky quartz. It is usually worn on the right wrist, the projecting side. Crystal Basket's protection pieces are 8 mm black and metallic beads, so they read as everyday jewellery rather than a talisman.

faq.q: Which crystal is traditionally worn for protection?
faq.a: Black tourmaline is the stone most traditionally worn for protection, followed by black obsidian and hematite. The Guardian pairs black tourmaline with hematite and a single gold-filled bead, and The Shield is a single row of polished obsidian for a simple, all-black look.

faq.q: Is a protection bracelet the same as an evil eye bracelet?
faq.a: No. An evil eye bracelet uses a blue eye charm, a tradition across the Middle East and the Mediterranean. A crystal protection bracelet uses natural stones such as black tourmaline and obsidian instead. Some people wear both, and they stack comfortably on the same wrist.
